alt-vo2max-per-km.label: VO₂max loss per 1,000 m of acute altitude in endurance-trained athletes
alt-vo2max-per-km.value: about 6.3% per 1,000 m (range 4.6–7.5%), linear from 300 to 2,800 m

alt-hbmass-100h.label: Haemoglobin mass gain during altitude exposure
alt-hbmass-100h.value: about 1.1% per 100 h of exposure; about 3.3% above baseline for up to 20 days after

alt-lhtl-dose.label: One group's recommended LHTL dose
alt-lhtl-dose.value: live at 2,000–2,500 m for at least 4 weeks and at least 22 h·day⁻¹
